action.objective: Complete broad depth-4 coverage of all legal White moves to find the strongest continuation while keeping the extra e5 knight pawn.
action.rationale: Feedback requires an initial broad search with candidate_moves=[] before any focused verification. We are a pawn up (e5 knight holds d5/f7 threats) but both white bishops and castling are undeveloped, so cover everything at depth 4 with the analysis node allowance.
